Swipe to see why one of the biggest names in venture just cut its recruiters.

Andreessen Horowitz has laid off most of its 34-person portfolio recruiting team, the group that helped startups it backs find and hire talent.

Reports say the firm is shifting its talent strategy toward its crypto and growth teams.

Some observers see it as a sign of how AI and slower hiring are changing what startups need from their investors.

Sources: NewsBytes, The Economic Times, Benzinga.

items.caption:
Swipe to see the YC startup that says every company will soon put an AI agent on every customer.

Outlit connects the tools a company already uses, like Stripe, Slack, Gmail and its CRM, into one profile per customer that AI agents can query. The goal: catch customers about to leave and find upsell opportunities.

Co-founder Josh Earle told Futurism that continuous monitoring is inevitable and that nothing the company does is illegal. He also said Outlit sees no obligation to notify the people being monitored or offer an opt-out.

That has made it one of the most debated YC companies this week.

Sources: Futurism, Gadget Review.

items.caption:
Swipe to see the startup putting AI agents in charge of clinic paperwork.

Confido Health began with AI voice agents that answer patient calls, and is now building CareOS, a system that runs the administrative work across a medical practice.

The US-based company raised a $12.5 million Series A extension led by Z47 (formerly Matrix Partners India), bringing its total Series A to $22.5 million. Together Fund and Blume Ventures also participated.

The money goes toward rolling CareOS out across multi-location medical groups.

Sources: Digital Health News, Fierce Healthcare, Runtimewire.

items.caption:
Swipe to see the Techstars startup going after healthcare's admin burden.

TechNovaTime builds AI that maps and automates the operational work inside health systems, the scheduling, billing and back-office tasks that eat into staff time.

The Baltimore-based company raised a $3.4 million pre-seed round, announced by Techstars.

The bet: every hour of admin that AI takes off a hospital team is an hour back for patients.

Sources: Techstars, Dealroom.
